Converts Oracle OVAL (Open Vulnerability and Assessment Language) XML data into normalized database models for vulnerability definitions.

## Key Components

### Types

- **`distroPackage`** — Internal struct pairing an OS version string with a `models.Package`, used as an intermediate representation during OVAL parsing.

### Functions

- **`ConvertToModel(root *Root) map[string][]models.Definition`** — Entry point that transforms a parsed OVAL `Root` into a map of OS version → vulnerability definitions. Skips rejected CVEs, handles the `no-details` viper flag to strip non-essential fields, and deduplicates slices to avoid single-entry DB storage issues.

- **`collectOraclePacks(cri Criteria) []distroPackage`** — Initiates recursive traversal of OVAL criteria trees to extract affected packages.

- **`walkOracle(cri Criteria, osVer, arch, label string, acc []distroPackage) []distroPackage`** — Recursively walks `Criteria`/`Criterias` nodes, parsing criterion comments to extract OS version, architecture, module labels, and package name/EVR (Epoch:Version-Release) tuples.

## Usage Example

```go
// Parse OVAL XML into a Root struct (parsing omitted for brevity)
var root oracle.Root
// ... unmarshal XML into root ...

// Convert to indexed definitions
defs := oracle.ConvertToModel(&root)

// Iterate by OS version
for osVer, definitions := range defs {
    fmt.Printf("Oracle Linux %s: %d definitions\n", osVer, len(definitions))
    for _, def := range definitions {
        fmt.Printf("  %s - %s\n", def.DefinitionID, def.Advisory.Severity)
    }
}
```

## Notes

- Definitions with `** REJECT **` in their description are silently skipped.
- When the `no-details` Viper flag is set, advisory metadata (title, description, severity, references) is stripped from all definitions before storage.
- Slice fields are explicitly copied (`append([]T{}, src...)`) to prevent multiple definitions from sharing the same underlying slice in the database.
